quests.title: The Length of the Burwood Hotel
quests.blurb: Before you say anything: yes, I know. I haven't walked the Burwood Hotel end to end since the light rail came to Burwood. You can tell me I am imagining it. Tell me after. Do it Anzac Day for me and photograph what's at the far end now. Do not make a scene about it.

to the far end
photograph what's there now

quests.title: Staffy Near Burwood Girls
quests.blurb: I would do it myself if I could leave the counter. A brindle staffy in a red bandana went over the fence at Burwood Girls at eleven. The paperwork says one thing and my eyes say another. Everyone in Burwood has definitely seen it and can't say where. There is no rush, but there is a Friday.

quests.title: RBT on the Emerald Hill
quests.blurb: It is the sort of thing you notice or you do not. There's a breath test set up on the Emerald Hill since eight at night. I have rung the number on the letter four times. My brother-in-law needs the ute at the far end of Burwood without a conversation. Whatever you find, bring it to me first.

steps.label: get past the breath test on the Emerald Hill
then meet the ute at the far end

quests.title: Bin Night, the Emerald Hill
quests.blurb: You look like you have twenty minutes. Somebody moves the bins on the Emerald Hill in front of my drive every Sunday night. It started small, the way these things do. Photograph the evidence and have a word; Burwood knows who. Take your time. Do not take a week.

steps.label: photograph the bins at the Emerald Hill
and the woman who moved them

quests.title: Lads Off the Emerald Hill
quests.blurb: I have been putting it off since Easter. Three of them in TNs on the the Emerald Hill steps, flogging vapes to schoolkids at school pick-up. It has been going on longer than I have admitted to anyone. Burwood used to move them on itself and now it rings me. That's the whole job. No catch.

steps.label: move the lads on from the Emerald Hill

quests.title: Tap On at Burwood Road
quests.blurb: You are the first person to stop all morning. My Opal says I owe nineteen dollars for a trip from Burwood I never took on the King's Birthday. It is not the money. It has stopped being the money. Take the same one to Strathfield and tell me what it charged you. Whatever it costs you, tell me and I will cover it.

steps.label: tap on at Burwood, tap off at Strathfield
come back and tell me the fare

quests.title: Two From Westfield Burwood
quests.blurb: My knees are gone, so. Two of whatever's going near Westfield Burwood, here, hot, before the footy at first thing. Half the street knows and half the street is pretending not to. It's Burwood; I'm not asking for much. You'll know it when you see it.

steps.label: pick up two from near Westfield Burwood
and get them here hot

quests.title: Sightline at Westfield Burwood
quests.blurb: Honestly, I am past caring how it looks. Insurance says nobody could have seen the ute hit the fence at Westfield Burwood on Australia Day. It is the not knowing that has got me, honestly. Stand where I stood in Burwood, photograph the view, tell me if I'm lying. Do not let them talk you into anything.

steps.label: stand where it happened at Westfield Burwood
photograph the corner
describe the sightline

quests.title: Counting Burwood Park
quests.blurb: I'll be straight with you. Council says the Burwood Park car park is never full and I say it's full by lunchtime. I have got no proof, which is exactly why I am asking. Count both Burwood car parks, photograph whichever one makes me right. Do that and we're square.

steps.label: count the cars at Burwood Park
then the other car park
photograph the fuller one

quests.title: Closing Time at Burwood Park
quests.blurb: There is no clever way to say this. Two blokes have slept in my doorway on Burwood Park since the pub shut. I am not after trouble. I am after an answer. The Burwood delivery's at first thing, so get them up and show me the step empty. Say nothing to anyone on the way.

steps.label: walk the two drunks off Burwood Park
and show me the doorway clear

quests.title: The the Burwood Chinatown Course
quests.blurb: The council knows and the council does not care. A bloke near the Burwood Chinatown runs a ninety-minute course he bills at four hundred, and I've paid. There is probably a simple explanation and I would love to hear it. Sit it Anzac Day, then come back to Burwood and prove it did something. Just do not come back empty-handed.

quests.title: Trolley Run, the Burwood Chinatown
quests.blurb: Right. Since you asked. A Woolies trolley from the Burwood Chinatown gets walked to the creek every the King's Birthday. I have got a photo on my phone but it is useless. Find where it ends up in Burwood and make the deposit back. If anyone asks, you were never here.

steps.label: find the trolley near the Burwood Chinatown
photograph where it ended up

quests.blurb: It is not a police matter and I have checked. A new speed camera near Belmore Street has fined half of Burwood since Wednesday. quests.title: Something From Belmore Street
quests.blurb: I am told you do odd jobs. The stall at Belmore Street has run out and the customers keep coming. You will see what I mean the second you get there. Find something round Burwood that'll do before the closing rush. Come and find me after, either way.

bring it to the stall

quests.blurb: I have written it down twice and lost it twice. The site at Belmore Street starts its jackhammer at lunchtime on a the last Sunday of the month, which is illegal and loud. quests.title: The the Burwood Hotel Sparky
quests.blurb: You will think I am making this up. The sparky off the the Burwood Hotel job has owed me since the bathroom and drinks in Burwood from knock-off. I am aware how that sounds. Forty will do and I'll write off the rest. I would rather know than wonder.

quests.blurb: Two people have already said no. Two lads and their mate decided at midnight that Burwood Girls is theirs. There is a version of this where I am the unreasonable one. The rest of Burwood disagrees, so explain the disagreement. There's cash in it. Not a lot.
